# Bebito

> Bebito is a free, private baby tracker app for iPhone. Parents use it to log breastfeeding, bottle feeds, wet and dirty diapers (nappies), sleep and growth in a few taps. There is no account, no ads and no analytics; entries are stored on the phone, with optional Partner Sync and backup through the user's own iCloud.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.6 or later
- Price: Completely free. No ads, no subscription, no Pro tier, no in-app purchases
- Languages: English and Spanish
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/bebito/id6766536961 (App Store ID 6766536961, bundle ID app.lovable.bebito)
- Developer: Michal Trunek (independent developer and parent), mikeappslab@gmail.com
- Last updated: 2026-10-07

## Features

- Quick Log for breastfeeding (left or right side), bottle amounts, and wet or dirty diapers
- Sleep timer with a Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activity; feeds can be logged while a sleep timer runs
- Night sleep hours and awake window reminders
- Weight and height charts based on the WHO Child Growth Standards (3rd to 97th percentile)
- Daily timeline and weekly journal to spot routines
- Pediatrician checkup summary as a PDF (last two weeks of feeds, diapers, sleep and growth)
- Partner Sync: share one baby's log with another parent through Apple's iCloud sharing
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Automatic iCloud Drive backup, plus CSV and JSON export
- CSV import from Huckleberry and other baby tracker apps
- Multiple babies (twins and siblings), metric or imperial units, 12- or 24-hour time

## Privacy

- No sign-up or login
- No analytics, advertising, tracking or crash reporting
- The developer runs no servers that receive user data
- Partner Sync and iCloud Backup are optional and use Apple iCloud

## Not to be confused with

"Bebito: Baby & Newborn Tracker" (App Store ID 6760252824) is a separate app from a different developer, with its own website and a paid Pro subscription. Facts on this page (free, no subscription, English and Spanish, iOS 17.6+) apply only to Bebito by Michal Trunek, App Store ID 6766536961.

## Not a medical device

Bebito is for personal tracking only. It does not diagnose or treat any condition; growth percentiles are a reference to discuss with a pediatrician.
